notes.title: Spring Sale & Big Reveals: New Games, Cozy Adventures, and Hidden Cat Mysteries!
notes.content:
Hello, dear Kittenbay explorers!

Your love for Kittenbay means the world to us! Seeing your enthusiasm and thoughtful reviews inspires us to craft even more magical adventures filled with hidden surprises and adorable felines.

[h2]Spring Sale is Here![/h2]

The Steam Spring Sale is in full swing, and if you’re looking to expand your collection, our Gemcraft’s Hidden Cat Bundle is available at a huge discount! This bundle includes Kittenbay, Kittenwood, and Hidden Cat Memories, giving you even more hidden object fun and feline-filled mysteries to uncover.

store.steampowered.com/bundle/43994/Gemcrafts_Hidden_Cat_Bundle/

[h2]Introducing Déjà View - A Spot The Difference Game (Q2 2025)[/h2]

We’re excited to announce our brand-new game, Déjà View - A Spot The Difference Game, launching in Q2 2025! Featuring original artwork by Bleeding Moon Studio, this game is a fresh and relaxing spot-the-difference experience—perfect for those who love engaging visual puzzles. While it’s a departure from our hidden object adventures, it brings the same level of charm and detail that you love.

Make sure to wishlist it now so you don’t miss any updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581940/Deja_View__A_Spot_The_Difference_Game/

[h2]Mermeows - Chill Cat Mermaids Arriving Late Q4 2025![/h2]

A new kind of cozy awaits! Mermeows - Chill Cat Mermaids is set to launch in late Q4 2025! Raise adorable cat mermaids, decorate tranquil ponds, and enjoy a heartwarming, stress-free experience.

Your wishlist helps us reach more players and bring Mermeows to life!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457460/Mermeows_Chill_Cat_Mermaids/

[h2]Two More Hidden Cat Games in Development![/h2]

We’re also working on two brand-new hidden cat games! They are still in the early design phase, so while we don’t have release dates just yet, we promise more feline adventures are on the way. Stay tuned!

[h2]Your Feedback Means Everything![/h2]

If you’ve enjoyed Kittenbay, we’d love to hear from you! Leaving a review helps us grow and brings our games to new players who adore hidden object adventures just like you.

Thank you for being a part of our journey. 

Happy gaming,
The Gemcraft Games Team

notes.content:
Hello, Cat Detectives! 🐾

This small patch focuses on optimizations we've made and also includes some minor fixes. Yes, we've attempted to fix that elusive bug with the Sunlit Safari Achievement once again! This time, we're confident that the issue is resolved.

Stay tuned, everyone, and enjoy Kittenbay!

notes.title: UPDATE PATCH 1.0.2 - New Features, Fixes, and a Special Thank You!
notes.content:
Hello Cat Detectives! 🐾 
We're excited to announce the release of version 1.0.2 for our game. Here's what's new and improved:

Bubble Text Duration Control: We've added a new feature that lets you adjust the duration of the bubble texts that appear when you click on our cats. Now, you can set the duration from OFF (to disable the bubble texts entirely) up to 8 seconds, giving you more control over how you interact with our feline friends.

Master Volume Control: Following your feedback, we've introduced a master volume control bar. This allows you to adjust the overall game volume to your liking, making your cat finding journey even more enjoyable.

UI and Typo Fixes: We've made several minor UI graphic improvements and corrected typos throughout the game to enhance your experience.

New Main Menu Page - Super Thank Scene: Look out for a new icon in the main menu - a small TV with a heart inside. Clicking on this icon will open a special "Super Thank" page. This page is our way of showing gratitude to the streamers who have supported and loved our game. It's a heartfelt thank you to those who have helped us grow and spread the joy of cat finding.

We're continuously working to improve the game and we appreciate all the support and feedback from our community. Thank you for being such an important part of our journey.

notes.title: UPDATE PATCH 1.0.1 - Fixed the Sunlit Social Safari Issue (Reset Needed)
notes.content:
Hey Cat Detectives! Here's a quick update for version 1.0.1.

We've fixed the achievement issue in Sunlit Social Safari that failed to trigger. Unfortunately, players already affected by this issue will need to reset their game while retaining their achievements and then re-click the humans at the top left corner. Meanwhile we also corrected several typos in the texts. Additionally, we've added a volume bar for the music after so many requests 😄

That's all for now!

Thank you for your support.

🌟 Happy cat finding! 🌟
